title: Meal Vouchers Cards service for the U.S. Embassy Brasilia, Brazil
agency_path: STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.STATE, DEPARTMENT OF.US  EMBASSY BRASILIA
detail_text: AWARD NOTICE : The U.S Embassy – Brasilia has completed its analysis of the proposals submitted in response to the subject solicitation. For information, we will provide you with the following data: 1 . The U.S. Embassy website and The SAM.gov was used to invite firms to participate in the solicitation. 2. The Government received a total of 02 proposals . 3. The contract has been awarded to: Pluxee 4. The award covers meal cards management services for the U.S. Embassy Brasilia . The total price for the basic period from April 01, 2026, until March 31, 2027, is BRL R$ 2,853,954.00. The total contract price, including the base and all options, is BRL R$ 14,269,770.00. 5. The award was made in strict conformance with the award criteria contained in the solicitation.
